s='''def transform(grid):
    # The full-width color bands define a cyclic vertical sequence. Use their
    # row positions to infer the cycle phase, then fill blank rows.
    n=len(grid)
    marks=[(i,row[0]) for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)]
    period=len(set(c for _,c in marks))
    # Colors in their top-to-bottom first-occurrence order define the cycle.
    seq=[]
    for _,c in marks:
        if c not in seq: seq.append(c)
    if not seq: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    # Align the cycle against all observed bands (the first occurrence anchors phase).
    anchor, color=marks[0]
    phase=seq.index(color)
    out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        if any(row): out.append(row[:])
        else:
            c=seq[(phase+i-anchor)%len(seq)]
            out.append([c]*len(row))
    return out
'''
